description: Order an item a verified business publishes (see list_business_offerings or find_businesses). Two steps. First call without confirm: it places nothing and returns the seller, the item, the quantity, the unit price, the full total, the currency, how payment happens, and the refund and cancelling terms. Show those to the customer. Then call again with the same fields and confirm: true, only after the customer agreed. The order goes straight to the business, where it already works: email, its own store or its own system, and the answer carries a reference to pass to get_order_status. When the business connected a payment account (Stripe, PayPal, Mollie, Razorpay, Lemon Squeezy or Paddle), the answer carries a pay_url on that account; the money goes to the business, never to Orbylon. For an appointment, the answer can carry a book_url where the buyer chooses the time on the business's own booking page.

confirm.description: Leave out to see the seller, the full price and the terms first. Send true only after the customer agreed to them.

fulfilment.description: How the buyer receives it, and how the business reaches them

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key when retrying

item.description: The item name exactly as listed

item_id.description: The item id from the catalogue
